$comment: The proof tier table (night-netrunner-Z2). The for-all tier: every harness turns a named law into a machine-checked verdict over ALL inputs in its stated domain. Every harness imports the same source modules the app bundles, through relative paths - a law the proofs verify is a law the app runs. The lane rides .github/workflows/proofs.yml with one invocation per harness, so a verdict is never lost to a sibling's budget; every job sits under the ten-minute estate ceiling. The census records the instruments examined and rejected (the honest NOs) - a NO is standing, not archival: scripts/gates/check-proof-manifest.ts re-reads this table out of the tree on every run and fails the day a harness, a source law, or a lane seat goes missing.

harnesses.theorem: the four-interval step function, for every real in [0, 1000], by totality + monotonicity + one-ulp boundary exactness
identity on the interior, wall outside, zero sentinel on non-finite input - total, monotone, idempotent
canonical lowercase two-chars-per-byte encoding, for every byte value and every byte pair, with a harness-side reference decoder round-trip
the unit-ladder decision table for every integer second in [0, 20000] plus one-ulp boundary windows at every high threshold
the seal decision truth table over the full keys x custody-states product, the tag guard over the hostile corpus, the seat and mirror-sequence laws
the hostile-envelope decision table for every integer on each axis plus the conjunction lattice - deciding all 8,388,608 triples of the product domain
the OWASP floor and caps hold for every tier in the complete ladder domain; the clamp is idempotent and fixpoint-stable; legacy envelopes still validate

census.reason: no pinned symbolic executor exists for the TypeScript engine modules; the for-all tier instead quantifies literally over each law's full stated finite domain, which is a stronger verdict than a bounded model check at the same cost

the engine is single-threaded; the concurrency that exists is the storage escalator's promise chains, which the db-atomicity suite already drives through the real IndexedDB implementation - a harness re-implementation would model the protocol, not the bytes the app runs

the sampled tier's coverage is delivered by the root lane's suites and the seeded corpora inside the harnesses; a new runtime dependency for shrinking buys nothing the regression discipline does not already pin

census.instrument: exhaustive await-interleaving model of the storage escalator (the zelynic Z17 shape)
census.reason: the escalator is engineered to eliminate the schedule space, not to prove it: same-key IndexedDB writes run inside a per-key promise chain (a total order by construction), stale jobs self-reject on the per-key write sequence, and mirror writes carry the latest-wins custody token; the interleaving properties are pinned where they live by the storage-write-seq, db-atomicity, and storage-coherence suites against the real IndexedDB semantics; a TypeScript interleaving harness would be a hand-written mini-scheduler - a model of the protocol rather than the bytes the app runs, the census law - and unlike the zelynic budget core the engine holds no shared-memory parallelism to model
